authority: Root is sole ledger/selector/closure-queue writer; subagents publish immutable proposals only.

preferred_completed_proposals_per_bundle.exception: Send a smaller bundle for a blocker, source-identity qualification, or a recovery boundary; do not defer saving partial reads to fill a bundle.

preflight: Require a read-only whole-bundle preflight mode; mutation follows only after every proposal passes, with exact ledger/selector hashes checked again by the sole writer.
Authenticate all immutable refs and exact prospective registration/source bytes/revision/hash/EOF/ranges/attribution before any authority mutation.

Inspect every nested range and qualification, including complete relevant functions, signature dependencies, unread tails and special visual/deletion contracts; no generic clipping or retrospective narrowing.
Qualify native packages against the source snapshot own lock/archive/member, not installed-version or current-main assumptions.
Preserve local finding IDs and explicit authoritative ID mappings; compare first contract and operation for aliases, not title or proposed remedy.
Fail before writes when any required check fails; preserve the failed proposal and additive correction.
Reuse inspected immutable rulesets at exact hashes. Avoid copying a historical validator just to select a different batch; exact new schema cases still require separate inspected checks.
adoption: Root reviews complete semantic projections and new strict ruleset delta once per larger bundle.
Root validates the entire bundle first, then adopts completed proposals in exact order; existing per-proposal receipts and hash checkpoints remain, even inside one orchestration call.
Apply contract revisits/closures and current-main delta dispositions to the one closure queue; no implied closure from body counts.
Recovery metadata records precise partial ranges/unread registrations after every bounded read packet, with broader preservation checkpoints at least every 10–15 minutes or major scope boundary.
current_main_delta: Reverify remote main at bounded reconciliation boundaries and before declaring current reconciliation complete.
On advance, append exact from/to revision, verified path/blob deltas and deletion/visual contracts to closure queue current_main_deltas. Preserve old proofs.

Give each affected path a separate disposition for every lens. Exact same-lens source identity/hash/range/attribution reuse needs an explicit proof; changed or extended scope requires prospective registration and body assessment.
Unchanged bytes, searches, staged files and another lens verdict do not close a delta or connected contract.
audit_closure_distinct_from_repair: Fully documented findings, policy questions, conditional cases and rejected suspicions can complete audit discovery after all required source/current/alias qualifications. Later repair acceptance and runtime checks are separately recorded, never required to be run under this audit-only goal.
protected_files: No product source/manifests/bindings/tests/fixtures/helpers/assertions/doctests edited; no product execution. Existing evidence validators and historical receipts remain immutable.
